title: Ha Tien Du Episode 6: The Serpent Awakens
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic
tone: Terrifying, powerful, dark transformation, unstoppable force

concept.hook: The potion burned through every meridian he had. And every meridian he didn't know he had.
concept.story_arc: Midnight agony → Meridians exploding open → Black energy erupts → Tower shakes → New power visible
concept.emotion: Terror → Agony beyond measure → Explosion of power → Absolute stillness → Calm terror

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the tower chamber. Ha Tien Du collapses onto the floor, hands clawing at the stone. His entire body is seized by violent convulsions. Black energy erupts from his skin in waves — like smoke, like serpents, like living darkness. Candles explode out. The Elder's robe whips in a supernatural wind. He watches impassively. Camera: wide shot — chaos in the chamber, black energy exploding from his body. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide shot — black energy explosion, chaos in chamber, his convulsing body, 6s
shots.narration: The potion did not wait. It consumed him immediately.
shots.sfx: Violent wind, his screams echoing, energy crackling, stone cracking

shots.prompt: Close-up extreme — his face in agony. Black veins now cover half his face, spreading across his left eye. His left eye is normal. His right eye: pure black, the Elder's eye. Living black energy swirls in the black eye. Tears stream down — but the tears themselves glow faintly black. His mouth open in a silent scream. Camera: extreme close-up — his half-transformed face, one human eye, one black serpent eye. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Extreme close-up — half human face, half black serpent transformation, 6s
shots.narration: His meridians were not just opened. They were shattered open. Every single one.
shots.sfx: Deep bass rumble, his breathing ragged, energy swirling, distant chanting

shots.prompt: Medium shot — from the Elder's perspective looking down at Ha Tien Du. A perfect circle of black energy radiates outward from his prone body, expanding across the floor. Ancient symbols on the floor — the Elder's own circle — light up in response. The two black energies connect. The tower itself groans. Dust falls from the ceiling. Camera: bird's eye — the energy circle expanding, connecting to Elder's symbols, tower shaking. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Bird's eye — energy circle expanding, connecting to elder's formation, 6s
shots.narration: The Elder's formation activated. Linking their powers. Binding them.
shots.sfx: Formation activating, stone grinding, energy connection hum, deep gongs

shots.prompt: Close-up — the convulsions stop. Silence. Ha Tien Du lies still. Then — slowly — he rises. His movements are no longer human. Fluid, serpentine. His torn gray robe hangs in strips. Black scales glitter faintly along his forearms. He opens his right hand — pure black. A sphere of living black energy spins in his palm. His smile: not human. Camera: medium close-up — his serpentine rise, black energy sphere, inhuman smile. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Medium close-up — serpentine rise, black energy sphere, inhuman smile, 6s
shots.narration: When he rose — he was no longer the same person.
shots.sfx: Energy sphere spinning, his serpentine breathing, Elder's slow clap

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the Elder and Ha Tien Du face each other in the ruined chamber. Candles all extinguished. Only the glow of black energy. The Elder bows — the first genuine respect. Ha Tien Du bows back. Then raises his head. His face: half calm, half barely contained darkness. He looks at the camera. Camera: wide shot — two cultivators bowing, dark chamber, his powerful dual-nature face. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Wide shot — two cultivators in dark chamber, his dual-nature face, 6s
shots.narration: The Elder had found his weapon. And Ha Tien Du — had found his path.
shots.sfx: Deep bass, two sets of footsteps, dark wind, ominous completion tone
